translationRepairs: He clashed with Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Asi over policy and, falling under suspicion, was sent out as Grand Protector of the Horse Herds.
He clashed with Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Asi over policy and, being resented by him, was sent out as Grand Protector of the Horse Herds.
見忌 after 與…論事不合 means Moluwo was resented or envied by Asi, not that he fell under vague suspicion; “being resented by him” restores that sense.

It campaigned against Western Xia, attacked the Tangut, broke the Zubu, pacified the Dilie, and the tribes were all shaken with fear; at the sound of war drums their courage fell from their bellies and their leggings dropped — this may truly be called a fiercely martial state.

It campaigned against Western Xia, attacked the Tangut, broke the Zubu, pacified the Dilie, and the tribes were all shaken with fear; at the sound of war drums their courage failed and their thighs trembled — this may truly be called a fiercely martial state.
膽落股弁 is courage failing and thighs trembling; “courage fell from their bellies and their leggings dropped” misreads both 膽落 and 股弁.
